title: The Precision-Recall Plot Is More Informative than the ROC Plot When Evaluating Binary Classifiers on Imbalanced Datasets
study_context: Methodological evaluation of binary classifiers under class imbalance.
population_or_data: Methodological evaluation of binary classifiers under class imbalance.
task: Methodological evaluation of binary classifiers under class imbalance.
method: Evaluation methodology for ROC and precision-recall interpretation.
main_findings: Precision-recall complements ROC by examining true positives among positive predictions in imbalanced classification.
limitations: Selected abstract page only; does not establish significance of an AP difference, invalidate AUROC, or validate a clinical threshold in SMC.
does_not_establish: Selected abstract page only; does not establish significance of an AP difference, invalidate AUROC, or validate a clinical threshold in SMC.
relevance_to_project: Interpret presence-mask ablations and rare-positive ranking metrics without claiming a local causal mechanism.
